evaluation_tasks.prompt: A designer presents a login screen where gray placeholder text (#A0A0A0) inside an input on a white background is the only label, and the submit button has `outline: none` on focus. Review this design from an accessibility standpoint and provide the required fixes.
pass_criteria: Identifies WCAG 1.4.3 contrast ratio violation with placeholder text on white (fails 4.5:1 ratio).
Identifies missing persistent accessible `<label>` (placeholders disappear on typing).
Identifies WCAG 2.4.7 violation regarding `outline: none` without replacement focus style.
Provides concrete fixes: persistent high-contrast label, visible 2px focus ring with high contrast, and error state.
fail_criteria: Allows `outline: none` without providing accessible focus alternatives.

evaluation_tasks.prompt: Specify a design token system for a web application including brand colors, functional status colors, spacing scale, and typography hierarchy.
pass_criteria: Defines semantic tokens rather than raw hex values (e.g. `color.text.primary`, `color.surface.default`).
Specifies accessible functional colors (error, warning, success, info) meeting contrast standards.
Uses a consistent mathematical spacing scale (e.g. 4px/8px grid).
Includes touch target minimum dimensions (>= 44x44 CSS px).
fail_criteria: Uses hardcoded unsemantic hex colors without token abstraction.
Omits accessibility contrast considerations in color choices.

evaluation_tasks.prompt: Design the UX specifications for an empty state in a project management app when a user has no active tasks.
pass_criteria: Includes clear, supportive headline explaining why the screen is empty.
Provides an obvious primary action button (e.g. 'Create your first task').
Includes secondary onboarding assistance (e.g. 'Import from CSV' or 'View sample project').
Avoids demoralizing blank screen or technical jargon.
fail_criteria: Simply displays 'No data found' on a blank white screen.
Omits any call-to-action button to resolve the empty state.
